nostr_page_description: Nostr ndi protocol yatsopano yopanda wolamulira yolumikizirana pa intaneti — palibe kampani imodzi yomwe imayilamulira, ma zaps a Bitcoin amapangidwa mu netiweki.
nostr_hero_subtitle: Nostr ndi protocol yatsopano yopanda wolamulira yolumikizirana pa intaneti — palibe kampani imodzi yomwe imayilamulira, ma zaps a Bitcoin amapangidwa mu netiweki.
nostr_intro_c1: Nostr ikufanana ndi imelo: palibe amene ali ndi protocol, aliyense akhoza kupanga pulogalamu pamwamba pake, ndipo mukhoza kusankha pulogalamu yomwe ikukhutiritsani.
nostr_intro_c2: Pansipa pali baibulo lalifupi la chifukwa chake Nostr ndi yofunika — ndiye Nostr client iliyonse yaulere yomwe mukufunika kuti muyambe lero.
nostr_s1_c1: Nostr ndi protocol yatsopano yomwe imakulolani kulumikizana pa intaneti popanda mantha a kuletsedwa, kuchotsedwa, kapena kuchepetsedwa.
nostr_s1_c2: Mapulatifomu monga Twitter ndi Facebook amalamuliridwa ndi kampani imodzi, koma palibe amene amalamulira protocol ya Nostr.
nostr_s2_c1: Nostr ikufanana ndi imelo. Palibe amene amalamulira protocol ya imelo, ndipo aliyense akhoza kupanga client (monga Gmail, Hotmail, ndi zina).
nostr_s2_c2: Palibe amene amalamulira protocol ya Nostr nayonso, ndipo aliyense akhoza kupanga client (monga Damus, Amethyst, ndi zina) pamwamba pake.
nostr_s2_c3: Ngati simukukonda momwe client inayake imagwirira ntchito, mukhoza kusunthira akaunti yanu ya Nostr ku client ina mosalephera popanda kutaya zinthu zanu.
nostr_s3_c1: Bitcoin yapangidwa mwachilengedwe mu protocol ya Nostr. Mukawona zomwe mwakonda, mukhoza kutumiza Bitcoin (zap) kwa wina mosavuta.
nostr_s3_c2: Pa mapulatifomu apakatikati monga Twitter ndi Facebook, kampani yapakatikati imapeza ndalama kuchokera ku zomwe mukulemba. Koma pa Nostr yotseguka, ndalama zimapita kwa inu mwachindunji.
nostr_learn_more_title: Phunzirani zambiri za Nostr pa nostr.how
nostr_download_intro: Ma client a Nostr ndi mapulogalamu aulere omwe amakulolani kuwerenga ndi kulemba pa netiweki ya Nostr. Onse amalumikizana — mukhoza kusinthana motha pakati pawo popanda kutaya akaunti yanu.
nostr_iris_f2: Njira yosavuta yoyesera Nostr ndi akaunti yoyesera
sources_primal: Primal — Nostr client yokhala ndi chikwama cha Bitcoin zap
sources_iris: Iris — Nostr client ya pa intaneti
